title: G.A.D: Grids Are Dumb - A Crafting Overhaul
description: A crafting menu overhaul because Minecraft's crafting system is needlessly complicated.
body:
# G.A.D: Grids Are Dumb

GAD is a crafting screen replacement that changes the menu from the grid based puzzle mechanic to a crafting list menu similar to other survival games.

![The crafting menu in the flesh!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06f5fa87830a1507b42c1f4938c472fc8f463cf1.png)

- Are you tired of sprawling around wikis just to find that one modded item's crafting recipe?
- Are you someone like those streamers trying to craft a pickaxe using porkchops?
- Do you find Minecraft's crafting system overly complicated?

Then GAD is _~~probably~~_ the mod for you!

This mod is made for pack devs in mind, everything is configurable and you can even reenable the crafting grid if you so desire.

If a recipe is too large, it will require a crafting table in proximity of the player. (Configurable)

Features:
- Recipe menu openable via keybind.
- Support for recipes with any number of ingredient entries and per-entry counts.
- Scrollable recipe browser tied to the player's inventory.
- Inclusion of vanilla crafting-table recipes.
- Support for data driven workstations.
- Datapack recipe support through the custom **gad:gad_crafting** recipe type.
- Inventory integration that can hide the normal 2x2 player crafting grid.
- Enable or Disable automatically added recipes.

Supported crafting types:
- Crafting Grid Recipes
- Leather Dye
- Shulker Box Dye
- Decorated Pot
- Firework Star
- Firework Star Fade
- Firework Rocket
- Suspicious Stew
- Tipped Arrow
- Shield Decoration
- Banner Duplication
- Map Cloning
- Map Extending
- Book Cloning
- Item Repairs


# FAQ

### A recipe type is not supported, can you add it?
Possibly, contact me if a custom recipe type isn't working.

### Will you support Fabric and Neoforge?
Neoforge is planned, Fabric is still a maybe for now.

### I have an idea for a feature!
Contact me on my socials, I'd love to hear!
